LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionRecruitQuest.questDe:
questDescription->A stabilized feather-like projection has appeared near your colony.

The visitor calls herself Neiyu. She is not the full original self, but rather a lively projection cast into this world by a Milira from beyond. Rather than some aloof divine remnant, she feels more like a bright gust of wind that stepped in with a smile.

She is willing to stay, or to disperse here and now. The choice is yours.
